title: Expert Brain Terminology
description:
The domain's vocabulary. Atlas lists Terminology as first-class Expert Brain content, and it earns that place for two concrete reasons rather than as documentation:

1. Layer 5.2 renders cards in the operator's language. A card that says "the economic buyer is unengaged" to a team that says "budget holder" reads as a system that does not know the business.

2. Two teams authoring the same object under different names is the commonest way a knowledge base forks. `aliases` and `not_to_be_confused_with` are what catch it at review.

Grouped by area rather than one file per term — a term does not need independent versioning the way a playbook does.

  terminology/<area>.yaml

aliases.description: What else the profession calls it.

difference.description: The discriminator, stated. 'They are different' is not a difference.

object_ref.description: The object id that formalises this term, when one exists.

used_by.description: Capability ids where the term carries weight.

register.description: Whether Layer 5.2 may put this word in front of a customer. 'Churn risk' is internal; saying it to the customer is a different conversation.
